name: Concentric Rings
description: Nested rings in a mixed ink palette, sized by index and frozen mid-rotation until hover sets them spinning back into alignment.

code.style: --rule: ( @place-cell: center; @size: calc(150% / @size * @i); border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); transform: rotate(calc(@i * 10deg)); animation: concentricRingsRotate 2s ease-in-out 0s infinite alternate; animation-play-state: paused; @keyframes concentricRingsRotate { to { transform: rotate(0); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; grid-gap: -1px; overflow:hidden; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
